newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Monday on sporadic short-covering later in the day, reflecting the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 1.7 yen per kg higher. Benchmark May was up 0.6 yen at 143.0 yen.

Activity was lacklustre as most private investors retreated to the sidelines. "The market is waiting for fresh incentives. The upside at 144.0 yen for benchmark May could be hard to break through unless fresh factors emerge," one trader said.
